judgments.reason: Networks in language processing directly supply the method-purpose relation; retain the literal input and information-system context.

Keep weighted lattice extraction as one transformer-based composite method; for explicitly identifies Chinese NER as its purpose.
Expression recognition is explicitly the deep-learning case; high-performance computing is hardware context, not an additional AI method.
The title investigates model behavior under malfunction types; it does not settle a separate influence-computation task or diagnostic-use assertion.

The attention/hierarchy/deep-RL method is explicitly for lane-changing behavior in autonomous driving; keep the maneuver context.

All qualifiers specify the transformer network family; the short title names no separate operation or resource.
Foundation-model assistance is explicitly leveraged for remote-sensing segmentation; few-shot/class-generalization settings stay outside the base task.
OTA and optimal-transport assignment explicitly serve detection; Optimal is integral to the technical family, not promotional quality.

A description can be input text, not a method; retain uncertain reduction/personalization roles and no invented selection algorithm.
A2-RL and its complete aesthetics-aware learning description are explicitly for cropping; awareness defines the criterion rather than generic praise.
The spatiotemporal contrastive training mechanism and video modality identify one representation-learning method without a downstream task.
The ray-marching aggregation network explicitly serves indoor multi-view 3D detection; retain both name and mechanism description.
The object foundation model is explicit; Images and Videos names modalities and at Scale a scale condition, not benchmarks.
Prompt sampling and image generation are literal goals; internal criteria cannot be removed by inventing a discontinuous task phrase.
The expectation point may be a statistic, not the portfolio algorithm; deep RL's explicit application remains conditional on complete entity coverage.
For directly links deep RL to building HVAC control; no expansion of the acronym or building dataset is required.
